lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਆਏ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sa(n)tan jaaniaa too thaakur te aae paravaan ||
lines.translation: Those Saints who know You, O Lord and Master - blessed and approved is their coming into the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੬੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan kaa sa(n)g paaeeai vadabhaagee naanak sa(n)tan kai kurabaan ||2||41||64||
lines.translation: The Congregation of those humble beings is obtained by great good fortune; Nanak is a sacrifice to the Saints. ||2||41||64||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮੋਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu gat daiaal sa(n)tahu moree ||
lines.translation: Save me, O Merciful Saint!

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਤੂਟੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum samarath kaaran karanaa tootee tum hee joree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are the All-powerful Cause of causes. You have ended my separation, and joined me with God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਖਈ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਰੇ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke bikhaee tum taare sumat sa(n)g tumaarai paaee ||
lines.translation: You save us from the corruption and sins of countless incarnations; associating with You, we obtain sublime understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik jon bhramate prabh bisarat saas saas har gaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Forgetting God, we wandered through countless incarnations; with each and every breath, we sing the Lord's Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਤੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo sa(n)g mile saadhoo kai te te patit puneetaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever meets with the Holy Saints - those sinners are sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੨॥੪੨॥੬੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jaa ke vadabhaagaa tin janam padaarath jeetaa ||2||42||65||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, those who have such high destiny, win this invaluable human life. ||2||42||65||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰਨ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur binatee karan jan aaio ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, Your humble servant has come to offer this prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਸੁਨਤ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh aana(n)d sahaj ras sunat tuhaaro naaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Hearing Your Name, I am blessed with total peace, bliss, poise and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੂਖ ਕੇ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਸੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਛਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa nidhaan sookh ke saagar jas sabh mahi jaa ko chhaaio ||
lines.translation: The Treasure of Mercy, the Ocean of Peace - His Praises are diffused everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗ ਤੁਮ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g ra(n)g tum keee apanaa aap drisataaio ||1||
lines.translation: O Lord, You celebrate in the Society of the Saints; You reveal Yourself to them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਰਨ ਝਾਰੀ ਕੇਸਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: nainahu sa(n)g sa(n)tan kee sevaa charan jhaaree kesaaio ||
lines.translation: With my eyes I see the Saints, and dedicate myself to serving them; I wash their feet with my hair.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੪੩॥੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar darasan sa(n)tan kaa sukh naanak ihu paaio ||2||43||66||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Saints; this is the peace and comfort which Nanak has received. ||2||43||66||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee raam naam liv laagee ||
lines.translation: One who is lovingly absorbed in the Lord's Name

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਨੁ ਸੁਰਿਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan suridaa suhelaa sahaje so kaheeai badabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: is a good-hearted friend, intuitively embellished with happiness. He is said to be blessed and fortunate. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹਿਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਲਪ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahit bikaar alap maaiaa te aha(n)budh bikh tiaagee ||
lines.translation: He is rid of sin and corruption, and detached from Maya; he has renounced the poison of egotistical intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਆਸ ਏਕਹਿ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੀਐਂ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: daras piaas aas ekahi kee tek heeai(n) pri paagee ||1||
lines.translation: He thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and he places his hopes in the One Lord alone. The Feet of his Beloved are the Support of his heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਸੋਇ ਜਾਗਨੁ ਉਠਿ ਬੈਸਨੁ ਅਚਿੰਤ ਹਸਤ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: achi(n)t soi jaagan uth baisan achi(n)t hasat bairaagee ||
lines.translation: He sleeps, wakes, rises up and sits down without anxiety; he laughs and cries without anxiety.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਠਗਾਨਾ ਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਠਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੪੪॥੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jin jagat thagaanaa s maaiaa har jan thaagee ||2||44||67||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, she who has cheated the world - that Maya is cheated by the humble servant of the Lord. ||2||44||67||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab jan oopar ko na pukaarai ||
lines.translation: Now, no one complains about the Lord's humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਕਾਰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pookaaran kau jo udam karataa gur paramesar taa kau maarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever tries to complain is destroyed by the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਓਹੁ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaavai har daragah ohu haarai ||
lines.translation: Whoever harbors vengeance against the One who is beyond all vengenace, shall lose in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aad jugaad prabh kee vadiaaee jan kee paij savaarai ||1||
lines.translation: From the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, it is the glorious greatness of God, that He preserves the honor of His humble servants. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae sagal bhau mitiaa charan kamal aadhaarai ||
lines.translation: The mortal becomes fearless, and all his fears are taken away, when he leans on the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੪੫॥੬੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai bachan japio naau naanak pragat bhaio sa(n)saarai ||2||45||68||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name, through the Guru's Word, Nanak has become famous throughout the world. ||2||45||68||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਸਗਲਾ ਆਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan chhodiaa sagalaa aap ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servant has discarded all self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jaanahu tiu rakhahu gusaaee pekh jeevaa(n) parataap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As You see fit, You save us, O Lord of the World. Beholding Your Glorious Grandeur, I live. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur upades saadh kee sa(n)gat binasio sagal sa(n)taap ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Instruction, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sorrow and suffering is taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mitr satr pekh samat beechaario sagal sa(n)bhaakhan jaap ||1||
lines.translation: I look upon friend and enemy alike; all that I speak is the Lord's meditation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਆਘਾਨੇ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: tapat bujhee seetal aaghaane sun anahad bisam bhae bisamaad ||
lines.translation: The fire within me is quenched; I am cool, calm and tranquil. Hearing the unstruck celestial melody, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਦ ॥੨॥੪੬॥੬੯॥
lines.transliteration: anad bhaiaa naanak man saachaa pooran poore naad ||2||46||69||
lines.translation: I am in ecstasy, O Nanak, and my mind is filled with Truth, through the perfect perfection of the Sound-current of the Naad. ||2||46||69||
